title: Sure mini app manifest (miniapp.json)
description: Describes a Sure mini app: who it is, which file to open, and which permissions it asks the family admin to grant.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor support.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier. Installing a bundle with the same id upgrades the installed app and keeps its storage.

name.description: Name shown in the Apps list and the page title.

version.description: Version of this bundle, for example a semantic version (letters, digits, '.', '+' and '-'; at most 32 characters).

description.description: Short description shown at install and in the Apps list.

entry.description: Path of the HTML file to open, relative to the bundle root.

icon.description: Lucide icon name used in Sure's navigation and Apps list.

permissions.description: Permissions the app requests. The admin may grant any subset; ask only for what you use.

slots.description: Where the app's UI appears. Bridge version 1 supports only the full-page slot.

network.description: HTTPS origins the app may fetch from (they become the frame's connect-src). Leave empty for an app that works offline.

homepage.description: Where people can learn more about the app.
